_README: BK's Office · theme file · container proof only. Every string a student would read is a PLACEHOLDER until Leo's theme-1 draft is approved by BK in chat and ported here word for word. The shape is the contract: lesson.cards[].trait must be one of the building's four Be words exactly; every practice and mystery item carries two hints, a reason, and a note per wrong choice; news links need filter_checked:true before they show; nothing anywhere names BK's address or the district domain.
